Add a dependency to Largo.toml.

Accepts `name` (any version), `name@version`, or `logos:name` (the registry URI form). `--path` and `--git` record local and git dependencies. Edits preserve the manifest's comments and formatting.

Usage: largo add [OPTIONS] <SPEC>

Arguments:
  <SPEC>
          The dependency: `name`, `name@version`, or `logos:name`

Options:
      --path <PATH>
          Use a local path dependency

      --git <GIT>
          Use a git dependency

  -q, --quiet
          Suppress informational output (errors still print)

  -v, --verbose...
          Increase output verbosity (repeatable)

      --color <WHEN>
          When to use terminal colors

          Possible values:
          - auto:   Color when stdout/stderr is a terminal and `NO_COLOR` is unset
          - always: Always emit ANSI, even into pipes (CI logs, `less -R`)
          - never:  Never emit ANSI
          
          [default: auto]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
  largo add math_utils
  largo add math_utils@1.2
  largo add logos:std
  largo add local_lib --path ../local_lib
  largo add remote --git https://example.com/remote.git
